title: Magic Knight Rayearth
native_title: 魔法騎士 レイアース
overview:
Save this world... O legendary Magic Knights...

In addition to the anime's story, a Sega Saturn original story has been added!! Not only Rayearth fans but also those who don't yet know the world of Rayearth can enjoy it.

The definitive next-generation RPG

Three schoolgirls, Hikaru, Umi and Fuu, meet by chance at Tokyo Tower and are swept away in a flash of light to the other world of Cephiro. Princess Emeraude, the Pillar who protects the land, has been imprisoned, and the girls set out on a quest to rescue her.

In this action RPG you control all three heroines, each with her own weapon, magic, health and magic gauges, and switch between them at any time. Explore towns, talk with the people of Cephiro, solve puzzles and fight through dungeons. Animated scenes tell the story, and the girls write illustrated diary entries when you save.

- 1 player
- Based on the Magic Knight Rayearth anime
- Memory backup support

この世界を助けて……伝説の魔法騎士たちよ……

アニメのストーリーに加えセガサターンオリジナルストーリーも追加!!
レイアースファンはもちろんまだレイアースの世界を知らない人も楽しめる。

次世代ロープレの決定版
